project_type: Expo React Native app for Android TV/Google TV - part of HIJISTREAM monorepo
build_system: Bun + Expo CLI (npx expo). Bun is the package manager (not npm).
test_framework: No test framework specified in TDD - validation via Expo export (static build) and lint
verification_instructions: 1. Run `bun install` to install dependencies. 2. Run `bun run lint` to check for code issues. 3. Run `bun run export` to verify the app builds (Expo static export).
setup_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/mobile. 2. bun install. 3. Verify expo CLI works via bunx expo --version.
environment_constraints: No Android emulator or physical device available. Validation limited to Expo static export and lint checks. No Docker needed.
contribution_requirements: Use Bun exclusively (not npm/yarn). Follow same patterns as web app for API, caching, and player utilities. Target Android TV (API 24+).
key_patterns: Web app uses: localStorage-based caching with TTL, iframe embed player via vaplayer.ru, @tanstack/react-query for data fetching, file-based routing. Mobile should mirror these with AsyncStorage and react-native-webview equivalents. Same API endpoints and cache key conventions.
directory_structure: /apps/web/ - existing web app (React+Vite), /apps/mobile/ - new Expo React Native app to be created. Mobile app structure: src/app/ (Expo Router file-based routing), src/components/, src/utils/
